description:
Activate Grim Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Forsaken Monument triggers, adding {C}.
Activate Grim Monolith's second ability by paying {4}.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Grim Monolith's ability.
Resolve the first Grim Monolith ability, untapping it.
Activate Grim Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Forsaken Monument triggers, adding {C}.
Resolve the second Grim Monolith ability from step 3, untapping it.
Repeat.
